description: This is a JUnit test class for the ConnectionStatusMessageMapper in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It contains unit tests verifying the mapping of external messages to internal signal representations, configuration validation, and handling of header properties.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusMessageMapperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ConnectionStatusMessageMapper, testing message mapping, configuration handling, and header property validation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data and configurations before each test.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCase
methods.description: Tests mapping of a valid external message with typical header properties.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCaseTtdZero
methods.description: Tests mapping when TTD (time-to-die) header is zero.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithValidUseCaseTtdMinusOne
methods.description: Tests mapping when TTD header is -1, representing unlimited or distant future.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeaderTTD
methods.description: Validates behavior when TTD header is missing.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeaderCreationTime
methods.description: Validates behavior when creation time header is missing.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithMissingHeader
methods.description: Tests handling of missing or invalid header placeholders.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidHeaderTTD
methods.description: Tests behavior when TTD header has invalid value.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidHeaderCreationTime
methods.description: Tests behavior when creation time header has invalid value.

methods.name: doForwardMapWithInvalidTTDValue
methods.description: Tests mapping when TTD header has a negative or invalid numerical value.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithoutFeatureId
methods.description: Validates default feature ID assignment when none is specified.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithoutThingId
methods.description: Expects exception when thing ID is missing in configuration.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithWrongThingId
methods.description: Expects exception for invalid thing ID value.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithThingIdMapping
methods.description: Validates mapping when header placeholder for device ID is used for thing ID.

methods.name: doForwardMappingContextWithWrongThingIdMapping
methods.description: Expects empty mapping result if thing ID mapping is invalid.

methods.name: extractProperty
methods.description: Helper method to extract a specific property from a ModifyFeature.

methods.name: getDefinitionIdentifier
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve the feature definition identifier from a ModifyFeature.
